== Appium automation

- On iOS simulators, the Appium commands `mobile: queryAppState` and `mobile: isAppInstalled` now return the app state and installation status. Previously, both commands failed with a server error for every bundle ID, whether the app was installed or not, so scripts that polled for an app to reach the foreground or checked installation before installing stopped with an error. Real iOS devices were not affected.
